nodes.label: graphify Reference: Transcribe Video and Audio
Whisper Transcription with Domain-Hint Prompt
nodes.rationale: Video/audio cannot be read directly, so Step 2.5 transcribes them first and treats transcripts as doc files in Step 3. The agent (already an LLM) composes a one-sentence domain hint from the corpus god-node labels — no separate API call. GRAPHIFY_WHISPER_PROMPT and GRAPHIFY_WHISPER_MODEL must be `export`ed (not just assigned) so the child Python process sees them, and the transcript JSON is written by Python, not a shell redirect, so Whisper's stdout progress can't corrupt it (#1392).
